description: This file defines an enumeration for CPU architectures and declares functions related to obtaining the host architecture as a string, the host architecture enum, and checking compatibility between architectures.

classes.name: Arch
classes.description: An enum class representing different CPU architectures such as ARM, ARM64, RISC-V 64-bit, x86, and x86_64.

methods.name: HostArchStr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the host architecture.

methods.name: HostArch
methods.description: Returns the architecture of the host as an Arch enum value.

methods.name: IsHostCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a given architecture is compatible with the host architecture.
